summary: This is an at-the-market (ATM) offering prospectus supplement filed by Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco, Inc. The registrant may sell up to $3,513,524 of Class A common stock through agent Needham & Company under a Sales Agreement. No shares are required to be sold; the agent receives up to 3.0% commission. The filing is a routine shelf takedown using Rule 415(a)(4) and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring. It is purely a capital-raising vehicle, not a change-of-control or strategic event.
